The structure of Yb2Bi4 (YbBi2) is tetragonal, space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 6-atom unit cell and 2 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives Bi centers 9 neighbors (6 Bi, 3 Yb) over 2.72–3.47 Å, while Yb centers show 14 neighbors (10 Bi, 4 Yb) over 3.12–3.47 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is 3-dimensional and connected across all 6 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between 9-vertex Bi and 14-vertex Yb polyhedra, plus edge sharing among Bi polyhedra.
